What we do

Whole animal to wrapped box, all in Clermont.

Everything happens here. You bring the animal, you tell us how you want it cut, and you pick it up labeled, wrapped, and ready for the freezer.

Beef

Steers and cows from live animal to boxed beef. Halves, quarters, or the whole thing, hung and cut to your sheet.

Hogs

Chops, roasts, ribs, and ground pork, plus bellies and hams sent straight to the smokehouse if you want them there.

Custom Cut & Wrap

Steak thickness, roast size, how much you want ground. We hand you a cut sheet, spell it out, and everything comes back labeled.

Smokehouse

Bacon, hams, and bellies smoked the old way in our own house. It is right on the sign out front for a reason.

Fair & Show Animals

4-H and FFA projects are our people. We are at the shows, we know the buyers, and we get everybody their meat cut right.

In Store Pickup

Everything gets picked up here at the shop, boxed and ready to load. Monday through Thursday mornings.

The part that matters

USDA inspected is not a sticker. It is a business decision.

Most small processors in Florida run custom exempt, which legally means the meat can only go back to whoever owned the animal. It can never be sold. Fine for your own freezer; a dead end if you want to build something.

  • You can sell it. Meat processed under federal inspection can go to farmers markets, restaurants, retail shelves, and straight to your customers by the box.
  • An inspector is on site. Every animal examined before and after harvest, and the mark of inspection on every package.
  • You are building a real brand. Producers selling beef shares, quarters, or freezer boxes need this. There is no workaround.
  • And we are open to the public. You do not have to be a commercial operation to book a date with us.
The smokehouse

Smoking hot service since 1972.

The smokehouse is the part people drive an hour for. Bellies and hams go in on the rack and come out the color of an old penny; bacon that tastes like bacon used to taste, before it came shrink wrapped from six states away.

  • Bacon and side meat from your own hog, sliced and packed however you want it.
  • Whole and half hams, smoked slow and ready for the holidays.
  • Add it to any hog order when you drop off; just tell us at the counter.
How it works

Four steps, no surprises.

Call and book

Ring (352) 394-6465. We are scheduling months out, so the earlier you call the better your date.

Bring the animal

Drop off at the Hoboh Lane plant during your window. We take it from there.

Fill out your cut sheet

We hand you a sheet, walk you through every option, and text you if anything needs a decision.

Pick it up

Wrapped, labeled, boxed, and freezer ready. Back your truck up and go.

Fair & show animals

We have been in those bleachers for fifty years.

Lake County Fair, Southeastern Youth Fair, and every 4-H and FFA sale in between. If your kid raised it and somebody bought it, we know exactly how to get that buyer their meat cut the way they asked.

  • Buyers welcome. Tell us your cuts and we handle the rest; you never have to set foot in a barn.
  • Families welcome. First time showing? We will walk you through what happens after the sale.
  • Book early. Fair season fills our calendar faster than anything else all year.
